content.text: Route: fast-path quick bug lane. Evidence: reproducing `renderThemeLabel({ theme: "unset" })` shows the visible label is `unset`. Root Cause: `normalizeTheme` only handles falsy values, so the string sentinel is preserved. Change Necessity: user-visible need is to avoid showing `unset`; no-change / non-code option cannot repair a value already flowing through the normalizer; why code change is necessary is that the canonical owner must normalize the sentinel; minimum change boundary is `normalizeTheme` plus one regression check; Decision: code-change. Source edit intention: now edit only `normalizeTheme` plus one regression check. Canonical owner: `src/settings.js` `normalizeTheme`, not a renderer fallback. PatchShape: fix owner, no fallback.
